---
id: cst-0002
kind: constraint
title: Never deploy to prod without a green CI run
state: active
created: "2026-08-21T00:00:00Z"
---
A prod deploy on a red or unverified CI run has burned us before; this
constraint blocks that path until a human confirms otherwise.

```serenity:applies_when
action: deploy_to_prod
```
